rationale: The current ES 8.8 combined Premier Triage and Response aggregate row requires Cloud Platform 10.2.x+, ES 8.6+ and paired SOAR. The task requires Platform 10.2+, ES 8.7+, enabled assistant, paired SOAR, investigation permissions, a preexisting eligible finding, up to 10 findings from a single detection burst, approximately 200 per tenant per day, frontier models and inherited SOAR connector/action/asset permissions. The 8.7 task preserves historical AI SOC Analyst scope. CMP prerequisites are Platform 10.4.x+, ES 8.8+ and Cloud Connect 2.0; ES overview names SAIA 2.4+. Current 2.3.6 installation and known issue material still describe 2.4.0 Cloud Connected support as planned. The current ES release page confirms November 4 GA; the exact mapped historical October CA section is unavailable. Exact SOAR pairing, per-agent rollout, entitlement and customer authorization remain separate.

deployments: Premier Cloud and Cloud Connected CMP
exclusions: CMP has its separate Platform 10.4+/ES 8.8+/Cloud Connect 2.0 chain; no lower-floor eligibility, tenant rollout, entitlement, pairing or authorization is established.
